proof: Reflected out parameter types and names are in native_funcs.json; generated UCommonButtonStyle.h supplies matching reflected fields. Wrappers forward the out reference to the listed helpers. Brush helpers use FUN_14079cdf0 to assign the full brush, including shared ownership fields; native FSlateBrush assignment supplies that operation.
limitations: Existing panel runtime integration and generated declarations are outside this proposal. FSlateBrush compatibility and runtime rendering are not verified. Text-style accessors are excluded: their native bodies read an existing class default object and require a careful no-create class/CDO contract.
